summary: Verified BAE 4-field auto-fill behavior on both backend and frontend. Backend: 4/4 pytest tests pass — defaults fill when omitted or empty (marital_status='single', profession='Employee'|'Student', mother_name/father_name = last_name), explicit values are preserved. Frontend /basvuru: 'Medeni Hal', 'Meslek', 'Anne Adı', 'Baba Adı' input fields and 'BAE başvuru formu için gereken 4 ek bilgi' block are completely removed from Step 1; the passport OCR loading text is 'Pasaport bilgileri okunuyor...' with NO 'yapay zeka' phrase anywhere on the page. /takip still renders two columns (takip kodu + hesap girişi) and navbar 'Başvuru Takip' links directly to /takip; page headings are gold.
critical_code_review_comments: Apply.jsx is ~2060 lines — consider splitting into step-based subcomponents for maintainability.

TravelerIn.marital_status uses pattern '^(single|married|divorced|widowed)$' (no empty), so if frontend sends an empty string it would 422. Currently frontend hardcodes 'single' in payload (line 795), which is fine. Consider allowing empty in the pattern for defense-in-depth so _fill_uae_defaults can canonically set it.

FIELD_LABELS mapping still contains marital_status/profession/mother_name/father_name (used by OCR missing-fields feedback). Since the customer no longer sees these fields, OCR 'missing fields' toast could confuse users if these come back as missing — consider filtering them from the OCR missing_fields UI too.
